subject: Science
overview: Indha lesson-la objects endha materials-la seyyappattirukku, materials-oda properties, hardness, flexibility, solubility, transparency matrum matter-ai compare pannuvom. Oru object-ku suitable material-ai properties base-la choose panna kathukkolvom.
learning_objectives: Objects-ai avai seyyappatta materials base-la identify panna mudiyum.
Material properties-ai observe panni compare panna mudiyum.
Hardness, flexibility, transparency, solubility-ai explain panna mudiyum.
Different materials water-la dissolve aagudha-nu test panna mudiyum.
Matter-ku mass-um space occupy pannura property-um irukku-nu explain panna mudiyum.
Daily life-la material choice yen mukkiyam-nu example-oda solla mudiyum.

teaching_sequence.title: Objects-um materials-um
teaching_sequence.caption: Classroom-la irukkura tumbler, desk, book, ruler, bag-ai paarunga. Oru object oru material-la alladhu pala materials-la seyyappattirukkalaam. Object-oda use-ku suit aagura material choose pannuvanga.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Tumbler glass, steel, plastic-la irukkalaam. Ellam tumbler-thaan; aana material different. Oru object-ai seyyum material adhan properties-ai decide pannum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Oru object-um adhai seyyum material-um sollunga. Oru object pala materials-la seyyappadalaamaa?

teaching_sequence.title: Material properties observe pannuvom
teaching_sequence.caption: Materials colour, lustre, texture, hardness, flexibility, transparency madhiri properties-la differ aagum. Observation-ai table-la record panni compare pannalaam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Wood, metal, rubber, glass samples-ai safe-aa observe pannunga. Edhu smooth, rough, hard, flexible, transparent-nu classify pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Hardness-um flexibility-um enna? Oru material-oda rendu properties sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Hardness, flexibility, shape
teaching_sequence.caption: Hard materials-ai compress panna kashtam; soft materials easy-aa shape change aagum. Flexible materials bend aagum; brittle materials sudden-aa break aagalaam. Material property use-ai affect pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Rubber band stretch aagum; metal spoon easy-aa bend aagadhu; chalk brittle. Indha examples-la property eppadi use-ku connect aagudhu-nu paappom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Rubber band flexible-aa? Chalk brittle-aa? Indha properties-ku evidence sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Soluble matrum insoluble
teaching_sequence.caption: Salt, sugar water-la dissolve aagum; sand, oil dissolve aagadhu. Dissolve aaguradhu material disappear aagiduchu-nu artham illa; particles water-la spread aagirukkum. Stirring, temperature solubility-ai affect pannalaam.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Clear cups-la water eduthu konjam salt, sugar, sand add panni observe pannunga. Edhu dissolve aagudhu, edhu settle aagudhu-nu note pannunga. Edhaiyum taste panna vendaam.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Salt water-la enna aagum? Sand yen dissolve aagadhu?

teaching_sequence.title: Transparency matrum material use
teaching_sequence.caption: Transparent materials vazhiya objects clear-aa theriyum; translucent materials light-ai pass pannum aana image blur; opaque materials light-ai block pannum. Windows-ku glass use pannuradhu indha property nala.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Clear glass, tracing paper, cardboard-ai light-kku opposite-aa vechu compare pannunga. Light pass aagura alavu base-la group pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Transparent, translucent, opaque — ovvorondrukkum oru example sollunga.

teaching_sequence.title: Mass, volume matrum matter
teaching_sequence.caption: Matter-ku mass irukkum; space occupy pannum. Scale-la mass measure pannalaam; volume object evvalavu space occupy pannudhu-nu kaattum. Solid, liquid, gas ellam matter; air-kum mass-um volume-um irukku.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Empty cup-um water fill panna cup-um weigh pannunga. Air-filled balloon-um deflated balloon-um compare pannunga. Kannukku theriyadha air-um matter-nu evidence moolama purinjukkolvom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Matter-oda rendu properties enna? Air matter-nu solla enna evidence irukku?

teaching_sequence.title: Material-ai purpose-kku choose pannuvom
teaching_sequence.caption: Oru object design pannumbodhu strength, flexibility, transparency, water resistance, weight, safety ellam consider pannuvanga. Reuse, recycle, waste segregation environment-ai protect panna help pannum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Raincoat-ku waterproof material, window-ku transparent glass, cooking vessel-ku heat-resistant metal use pannuvom. Material choice use-oda match aaganum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Raincoat-kku endha property thevai? Window-kku glass choose pannuradhukku kaaranam enna?
